name: Hyatt Place Bangkok Sukhumvit 24
short_description: A 222-room select-service Hyatt Place near BTS Phrom Phong, with a 19th-floor pool and a 28th-floor rooftop bar.
ai_summary: Hyatt Place Bangkok Sukhumvit 24 sits near BTS Phrom Phong station, in reach of the Sukhumvit Soi 24 area's shopping and dining. The 222-room select-service hotel draws praise for its location and AIRE BAR, the 28th-floor rooftop spot with sweeping city views, along with a well-regarded breakfast. Rooms run on the smaller side for the category, and a few guests note soundproofing could be better, but reviewers consistently call out the location and rooftop bar as good value for a select-service stay.

faqs.question: Does Hyatt Place Bangkok Sukhumvit 24 have a pool?
faqs.answer: Yes -- a 15-metre outdoor pool on the 19th floor, along with AIRE BAR, a rooftop bar on the 28th floor with sweeping views of Bangkok and the Chao Phraya River.

faqs.question: Is Hyatt Place Bangkok Sukhumvit 24 close to the BTS Skytrain?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's near BTS Phrom Phong station, putting guests within easy reach of the Sukhumvit Soi 24 area's shopping and dining without needing a taxi for most trips. That also puts EmQuartier and EmSphere malls, along with a wide range of restaurants, within a short walk of the hotel.
